## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `212597240863bf5bfd56de64d6263a8458197286`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/agents/os-dev.md, AGENTS.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs

Read: card #31071 (body, triage, claim), PR #31079 (body, file list, net diff `origin/main...refs/seat3/pr-31079`: 3 files, +3 / −3, merge base `3f61e4f8`; `main` has moved one commit since, touching none of the cited paths), the head's check-runs, and the cited files at `origin/main` and the head. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**Each line still reaches the door.** The door on `main` and at the head (unchanged by this PR): `seat-post-protocol.md` L31 「PR 正文末非空行署 …,整篇经 `dispatch.mjs` 的 `issue_patch`」, with L32 directly under it: 「PR 正文不送页脚:中继 `issue_patch` 存 = 送、无追加(`platform-readings.md` 中继行)」.
- `rest-channel.md` L17 now reads 「…与 PR 正文单笔 `issue_patch`(`seat-post-protocol.md` 正文行)」. Its context is the PR-body `issue_patch`, so 「正文行」 can only mean the PR-body lines L31–32, the only lines in that file naming `issue_patch` on a PR body. L32 is 「不送页脚」. Reaches the rule.
- `platform-readings.md` L290 now reads 「⇒ 该正文改走 `seat-post-protocol.md` 的 PR 正文行」, under L289 (the seat edits the body to re-trigger `pr-automation.yml`). Same landing: L31, then L32. The `⇒` still says what it said before: the flake-reason edit goes through the door, not through raw REST `PATCH` (which appends a footer, L337).
- `SKILL.md` L313 (the `Metadata-protocol:` row) now ends `…through the PR-body line of references/seat-post-protocol.md)`. That is L31, then L32. Parentheses balance: the row's single `(the kind of change …` opened before and still closes once at the end.

**Nothing unique is lost.** What the PR drops from each line: 「,不送页脚」 (rest-channel L17), 「,不送页脚」 (platform-readings L290), and `, with no footer (references/platform-readings.md)` (SKILL.md L313). The rule is on L32 word for word. The only other content dropped is SKILL.md's file-level pointer to `platform-readings.md`. L32 carries a narrower pointer to the same file (「`platform-readings.md` 中继行」 = L343 「中继 `issue_patch` 不在此列…」). L343 sits inside the 「写侧 · PR 正文」 reading block (L332–353), and it reads as the exception to the list just above it, so a reader on L343 has the footer cells L332–342 in view. The reading stays reachable from the door.

**The chain is closed.** At the head, `git grep` over `.claude/**` and `AGENTS.md`:
- `不送页脚|no footer` finds only the home (`seat-post-protocol.md` L32) and three platform-readings cells: L335 (「改侧不送页脚」), L339 (「该格处方是不送页脚」) and L405 (the `PATCH` on a real issue body). These are measured per-cell readings and the evidence L32 cites. They are not pointers to the door, and the triage did not ask for them to be swept. Not copies.
- `seat-post-protocol` pointers: `os-dev.md` L66 (「席位经 `seat-post-protocol.md` 代写」) points without spelling the rule. `lanes/director.md` L83 and `seat-lifecycle.md` L23 and L63 point at other sections. Plus the three edited lines. None spells the rule.
- `页脚|footer`, other hits: `os-dev.md` L397–405 and `AGENTS.md` L427–443 are the attribution-footer rule (the two footer forms, 「不循环重贴页脚」, "Send the footer you want stored … never re-send a body that already carries an appended footer"). That is a different rule, homed in AGENTS.md. platform-readings L332–353 and L402–407 are readings.
- `正文行` hits outside the door's pointers (`os-dev.md` L276–277, `SKILL.md` L92 and L109, `dispatch-runbook.md` L163, `state-machine.md` L27, `triage-duties.md` L24) mean body lines in general.
- `PR 正文|PR body` across `.claude/**`: none of the other hits points at the door or spells a no-footer rule for body edits.

The door is now the rule's only home, and none of the copies the triage asked to sweep is left. Every factual claim in the PR body's "What changes", "Sweep" and "Line budget" sections matches what I read.

No false statement, no lost unique fact: no must-fix here.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff is `.claude/**` only and publishes nothing. `Clause-②: no` is right: there is no published schema, protocol or capability surface in the diff. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: nothing a metadata author can write changes. The PR body carries both declaration lines at line start, and `Check Changeset` concluded `success` on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Claim surface: rest-channel L17, platform-readings L290, SKILL.md L313. The diff touches exactly those three lines (one hunk per file, −1 / +1 each). No other line and no other file is touched, so it stays inside the claim.
- Tier: every path is under `.claude/` in objectstack. `check-governed-merges.mjs` `GOVERNED_SURFACES` row `claude-tree` (`.claude/**`, `tier: GOVERNED_TIER_S`, `tierRepos: ['objectstack']`) applies to all three paths, and no Tier H row is hit. The ALL-not-ANY rule therefore gives **Tier S (席内达档复核落地)**. Diff size is 6 changed lines, far under `HUMAN_MERGE_LINE_THRESHOLD` 3000. This matches the PR body's reading. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` concluded `success` on this head.
- Check-runs on `2125972`, read at 2026-11-07T03:06Z: 43 runs. 14 `success`, 22 `skipped`, 0 failure. 7 `in_progress`: Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI, release & engine gates. Not waited on.

### ④ Design judgment

- **One home per rule:** holds. The edit-side no-footer rule for PR bodies now lives once, on `seat-post-protocol.md` L32, under its door. Its three pointers point and no longer restate it. The attribution-footer rule stays homed in AGENTS.md (mirrored by os-dev's create-side forms), which is a different rule. The cell prescriptions in platform-readings are the measured evidence the home cites. There is no eval prompt to check against: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch` has no `evals/`.
- **Line budget** (ratchet at `origin/main`, unchanged by this PR):
  - `CEILINGS`: SKILL.md 319, platform-readings 458, rest-channel 82. The head has 319 / 458 / 82 lines, the same as `main`. Net 0 per file, headroom 0, no row moved.
  - `MAX_LINE_BYTES` = 120. rest-channel L17 goes from 118 to 105 B and platform-readings L290 from 78 to 65 B. Both are prose under the cap before and after.
  - SKILL.md L313 goes from 750 to 698 B and is fence-exempt as `classifyLine` reads it. Front matter is L1–L14. The file's only `isFence` lines (`/^\s*(```|~~~)/`) are L302 (```` ```text ````) and L319 (```` ``` ````). So `advanceState` carries `fence: true` from L303 to L318, and `classifyLine` returns `'fence'` for L313 before any byte or quote test. That holds before and after the edit.
  - No table row is touched, so the `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pins are unaffected.
- The change holds against the code it cites. The door text it relies on is on `main` and unchanged.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none.
